description: This Java class 'Convert' performs data type conversions on input map fields within the OFBiz framework's mini-language processing. It reads configuration from XML elements, converts input data accordingly, and updates the results map.

classes.name: Convert
classes.description: A class that converts a specified input field from the in-map to a different type and places it in the out-map, based on configuration.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the conversion parameters from an XML element.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the conversion operation on input data, updating the results map accordingly.
